units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 5) the participant does not meet the requirements set in the procurement documentation under paragraph 1, or the requirements set in the documentation under paragraphs 1.1, 2 and 2.1, where applicable, of Article 31 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 6) the cases specified in Article 14 of this Federal Law: paragraph 4, point 1, subpoint “а” (except in the case provided for in point 7 of this paragraph), and point 2, subpoint “а”; and paragraph 5, point 1, subpoint “а” (except in the case provided for in point 7 of this paragraph), and point 2;
units.label: Point 6 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 7) failure to provide the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(5) of this Federal Law, if they are determined under Article 14(2)(2) of this Federal Law (where the procurement documentation prohibits procurement of goods originating in a foreign State under Article 14(2)(1)(а) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 7 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 8) the participant is found to be an organization specified in Article 2(4) of Federal Law No. 127-FZ of 4 June 2018 “On Measures to Influence (Counteract) Unfriendly Actions of the United States of America and Other Foreign States”, where the works or services being procured are included in the list determined by the Government of the Russian Federation under that point;
units.label: Point 8 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 9) the cases provided for in Article 45(6) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 9 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 10) inaccurate information is found in the procurement application.
units.label: Point 10 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 12. The record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results must contain:
units.label: Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1) the date and place of determination of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results;
units.label: Point 1 Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2) information on the decision that an application complies with the procurement documentation or is rejected, with reasons, specifying the provisions of this Federal Law and the procurement documentation with which it fails to comply, and the provisions of the application that do not comply with the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 3) the values awarded to applications found to comply with the procurement documentation under the evaluation criteria provided for in Article 32(1) of this Federal Law, where such criteria are established in the documentation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 4) the ranks assigned under paragraph 10(1)(в) of this Article;
units.label: Point 4 Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 5) information on conclusion of a contract at a price increased under Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 6) information on the decision of each procurement commission member participating in examination of the applications concerning each application;
units.label: Point 6 Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 7) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 7 Part 12 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 13. A participant that submitted an application may, after the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results is signed but no later than the contract conclusion date, send the contracting authority a written request for clarification of the results of examination and evaluation of its application. Within two working days of receiving the request, the contracting authority shall send the participant the relevant clarification.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 14. A contract following a closed tender shall be concluded in the following procedure:
units.label: Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1) no later than three working days from the day following its signing of the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results, the contracting authority shall prepare and send, without its signature, at least two copies of the draft contract to the winner or, in the cases provided for by this Article, another participant (hereinafter in this Article, the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded). The draft shall include the information specified in Article 51(2)(1), subpoints “а”–“е”, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2) within the period specified in the procurement documentation, the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded shall sign and simultaneously send the contracting authority all copies of the contract and a document confirming provision of contract performance security, except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law. In the cases provided for in Article 37 of this Federal Law, it shall simultaneously send the information and documents specified in that Article;
units.label: Point 2 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 3) no later than three working days following receipt of the copies of the contract, information and documents sent under point 2 of this paragraph, but no earlier than ten days from its signing of the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results or the record provided for in point 4 of this paragraph, the contracting authority must sign the contract, except in the cases established by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 4) if the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded fails to meet the requirements of point 2 of this paragraph, it is deemed to have evaded conclusion of the contract. No later than two working days following expiry of the period for compliance with point 2 of this paragraph, the contracting authority shall:
units.label: Point 4 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: а) draw up a record of the participant’s evasion of conclusion of the contract, containing the date it is signed, the identification number of that participant’s application and the requirements the participant failed to meet;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: б) prepare and send the participant that evaded conclusion of the contract a notification that the record of evasion has been drawn up;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: в) send, in the procedure provided for in Article 104(10) of this Federal Law, a request to enter information on the participant in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers);
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 5) if the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded is deemed to have evaded its conclusion, or if the contracting authority refuses to conclude it under Article 31(9) and (10) of this Federal Law, the contracting authority shall conclude the contract under this paragraph with the participant whose application was ranked second in the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results. If that participant is deemed to have evaded conclusion of the contract, the contracting authority may conclude it under this paragraph with a participant whose application was ranked third or lower. Participants whose applications were ranked second and third must sign the contract in the procedure established by this paragraph.
units.label: Point 5 Part 14 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 15. If a closed tender is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted subject to the specific rules established by Article 77(2) and (4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.label: Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 1. A closed auction shall be conducted in the procedure established for a closed tender by Article 73(1)–(9) of this Federal Law and by this Article, subject to the following:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 1) the invitation shall be sent no later than one hundred and eighty days from the decision approving the closed auction, but no later than seven working days before the application deadline;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 2) in the case provided for in Article 73(5) of this Federal Law, the application period must be extended so that at least seven days remain from the day following dispatch of amendments to the procurement documentation to the application deadline;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 3) the procurement application must contain:
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: а) the information and documents specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law: point 1, subpoints “а”, “в”, “д”, “е”, “з”–“к” and “м”–“п”, and points 2 and 5;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: б) an extract (or a copy) from the Unified State Register of Legal Entities, if the participant is a legal entity, or from the Unified State Register of Individual Entrepreneurs, if the participant is an individual entrepreneur;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: в) information and documents (or copies) confirming provision of application security, if required by this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: г) a document (or copy) confirming the signatory’s authority to act on behalf of the participant, except where the application is signed by the individual, including an individual entrepreneur, who is the participant, or by a person listed in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities as entitled to act without a power of attorney on behalf of the legal entity, where the participant is a legal entity.
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 2. No later than ten working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the deadline for examining applications set in the procurement documentation:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 1) the procurement commission members shall examine the applications received and decide, for each one, whether it complies with the procurement documentation or must be rejected in the cases specified in Article 73(11)(1), (2) and (5)–(10) of this Federal Law, or because the information and documents specified in paragraph 1(3) of this Article were not provided or do not comply with the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall draw up the record of examination of applications and, after it is signed by the procurement commission members, sign it and send:
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: а) one copy of the record of examination of applications to the federal executive body specified in Article 72(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 2 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: б) to each participant that submitted an application, a notification containing the information specified in paragraph 3(2) of this Article concerning its application.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 2 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 3. The record of examination of applications must contain:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 1) the date and place of examination of applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 2) information on the decision that an application complies with the procurement documentation or is rejected, with reasons, specifying the provisions of this Federal Law and the procurement documentation with which it fails to comply, and the provisions of the application that do not comply with the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 3) information on the decision of each procurement commission member participating in examination of the applications concerning each application;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 4) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 4. Participants whose applications comply with the procurement documentation may participate, during the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), by submitting a price offer reducing the initial (maximum) contract price or the initial total of unit prices (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law). The procedure shall take place in the presence of procurement commission members as follows:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 1) immediately before the price-offer procedure begins, the procurement commission shall register the participants present. If the procedure covers several lots, it shall register participants for the relevant lot. On registration, numbered cards (hereinafter, cards) shall be issued to participants or their representatives;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 2) the auctioneer shall be selected from among the procurement commission members by an open vote of those members, by majority vote;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 3) the auctioneer shall begin the price-offer procedure by announcing its opening, the lot number if several lots are involved, the procurement subject matter, the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), and inviting the participants to submit price offers;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 4) price offers shall be submitted by reducing the current lowest offer by 5 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) (hereinafter, the “auction step”). If, after the last price offer is announced three times, no participant indicates an intention to offer a lower price, the auctioneer must reduce the “auction step” by 0.5 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices. The “auction step” may not be less than 0.5 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 5) after the auctioneer’s invitation under point 3 of this paragraph, a participant shall raise its card if it agrees to submit a price offer equal to the announced price or total of prices;
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 6) the auctioneer shall announce the card number of the participant that first raised its card under point 5 of this paragraph and the new contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), reduced by the “auction step”;
units.label: Point 6 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 7) if an offer submitted during the price-offer procedure reduces the contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) to 0.5 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), or below, the procedure shall continue as bidding for the right to conclude the contract, taking account of Article 49(3)(9) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 7 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 8) the price-offer procedure ends if, after the auctioneer announces the contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) three times, no participant raises a card. The auctioneer shall then announce the end of the procedure and the card number of the participant that submitted that price offer;
units.label: Point 8 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 9) if a participant does not submit a price offer or does not attend the price-offer procedure, its offer is deemed to be the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law).
units.label: Point 9 Part 4 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 5. No later than one working day from the day following the price-offer procedure, but no later than the date for determining supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results set in the invitation:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 1) on the basis of the application examination results in the record provided for in paragraph 2(2) of this Article and the price offers submitted, the procurement commission members shall rank each application found to comply with the procurement documentation in ascending order of its applicant’s lowest price offer, except in the case provided for in paragraph 4(7) of this Article, where applications from participants that submitted offers after the offer specified in paragraph 4(7) of this Article shall be ranked in descending order of their price offers, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. When ranking applications submitted without price offers, an application received earlier shall receive the lower rank number. The application of the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection shall be ranked first;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall draw up the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results and, after it is signed by the procurement commission members, sign it and send:
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: а) one copy of the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results to the federal executive body specified in Article 72(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 5 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: б) to every participant that submitted an application, a notification containing the information specified in paragraph 6(3) of this Article concerning its application.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 5 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 6. The record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results must contain:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 1) the date, starting and ending times and place of the price-offer procedure;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 2) the lowest price offer, or the highest price offer in the case provided for in paragraph 4(7) of this Article, submitted by each participant, indicating the offer submission times and the dates and times of submission of applications from participants that did not submit price offers;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 3) the ranks assigned under paragraph 5(1) of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Conduct of a closed auction
units.text: 4) information on conclusion of a contract at a price increased under Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 74
